findings.label: Middleware auth gap
findings.description: proxy.ts only protects /dashboard/* but all new feature pages live at /residents, /rooms, /plans, /rent, /payments, /deposits, /electricity, /expenses, /reports, /settings, /activity-log. The middleware-level edge redirect never fires for these routes. The (dashboard) layout's auth() call provides server-side protection, but the edge redirect is missing. Fix: update isDashboardPage to protect all non-public paths (invert: protect everything except /login and static assets).

findings.label: updateRoom totalBeds divergence
findings.description: updateRoom writes totalBeds to Room without syncing the Bed collection. The UI prevents this via a disabled field, but there is no server-side guard. Strip totalBeds from the update payload in updateRoom, or add a check that the new value equals the existing count.

findings.label: Orphan /activity route
findings.description: app/(dashboard)/activity/page.tsx was not deleted when activity-log/page.tsx was created. It is a live route at /activity with stale placeholder content. Delete it.

findings.label: joining_cycle due date unimplemented
findings.description: When billingMode is joining_cycle, the first RentRecord dueDate should be joiningDate.getDate() of the following month, not rentDueDay. The current code uses rentDueDay for both modes. Add a branch for joining_cycle or document as a known gap.

findings.label: Dead DB query in givePlanChange
findings.description: const resident = await Resident.findById(residentId).lean() is called after the update in givePlanChange but the result is never used. Remove it.
